mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 months signals a shift toward monetary easing, lowering discount rates and increasing the present value of expected equity cash flows, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction, reducing equity risk appetite and compressing discount rates, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in rate hike periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment benefits claims (PAYEMS) exceeding 1% month-over-month for two consecutive months signals weakening labor market demand, which compresses discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in labor weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) below 1% month-over-month for two consecutive months signals strengthening labor demand, which compresses discount rates and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in labor strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 101 for three consecutive months signals a supply-side contraction, which reduces future earnings expectations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in supply contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) above 101 for three consecutive months signals a supply-side expansion, which increases future earnings expectations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in supply expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in home sales (HOUST) below 1307 for two consecutive months signals a cooling housing market, which reduces equity price risk premiums and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in housing cooling periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in home sales (HOUST) above 1307 for two consecutive months signals a strengthening housing market, which increases equity price risk premiums and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in housing strengthening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
